title: OLS well that ends well
body: Tina wants to use OLS to predict a person's height, stored in a vector $$Y.$$ She makes use of an $$m$$ by $$n$$ design matrix $$X, $$ which contains $$m$$ rows and $$n$$ columns, including a column representing the intercept. Assume that $$X$$ and $$Y$$ meet all the requirements for OLS.
